product.name: Volumetric Video Editor
product.description: Software that converts VR180 camera footage into volumetric video with 8K+ resolution and 180° field of view, enabling deployment across multiple platforms.

product.name: UpscaleVideo.ai
product.description: AI-based software that increases video resolution from 8K up to 16K, supporting various input formats and professional output encoding.

product.name: Volurama: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)
product.description: Software that creates photorealistic 3D volumetric panoramas from short phone videos using computer vision and camera motion estimation.

product.name: Royalty Free Volumetric Video Library
product.description: A collection of volumetric videos captured in 8K resolution, available for use in various applications.

product.name: Open Source Volumetric Video Players
product.description: Software players for Unreal Engine 5, Unity, and Javascript/WebXR that enable playback of volumetric video content across platforms.
